purpose: Source-backed semantic region mapping contract for reference hand assets.
rules: A semantic region is active only when its geometry identifier is explicitly supported by the source asset or a traceable annotation derived from that source.
No Palm/Thumb/Index/Middle/Ring/Little/Wrist geometry ID is inferred from visual position or mesh order.
Until source-backed identifiers exist, region status remains not_established.
Reference geometry is never converted into user-specific health data.
